logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, position: "Flow Start", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]

http:request.doc:name: Fetching Pending Orders From DB SYS API

logger.doc:name: Pending Orders Retrieved
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, pendingOrdersCount: sizeOf(payload.data default []), correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/json
var orders = payload.data default []
--- { skippedOrders: orders filter ( $.status == "CANCELLED" and $.createdAt != null and $.cancelledAt != null and ( ( ($.cancelledAt as DateTime) - ($.createdAt as DateTime) ).hours ) < 6 ),
eligibleOrders: orders filter ( !( $.status == "CANCELLED" and $.createdAt != null and $.cancelledAt != null and ( ( ($.cancelledAt as DateTime) - ($.createdAt as DateTime) ).hours ) < 6 ) ) }

logger.doc:name: Orders Segregated Successfully
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, skippedOrdersCount: sizeOf(payload.skippedOrders default []), eligibleOrdersCount: sizeOf(payload.eligibleOrders default []), correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]

logger.doc:name: Skipping Salesforce Synchronization
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, orderId: payload.orderId, message: "Order skipped because it was cancelled within 6 hours", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { orderId: payload.orderId, syncStatus: "SKIPPED", syncMessage: "Order cancelled within 6 hours" }

logger.doc:name: Skipped Order Updated Successfully
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, orderId: vars.currentOrderId, message: "Skipped order status updated successfully", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]

logger.doc:name: Eligible Orders Ready For Salesforce Synchronization
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, eligibleOrdersCount: sizeOf(payload.eligibleOrders default []), correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]

logger.doc:name: No Pending Orders Found
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, message: "No pending orders available for synchronization", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]

logger.doc:name: Generating Salesforce Access Token
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, message: "Generating Salesforce access token", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/x-www-form-urlencoded --- { grant_type: "password", client_id: p("salesforce.auth.clientId"), client_secret: p("salesforce.auth.clientSecret"), username: p("salesforce.auth.username"), password: p("salesforce.auth.password") }

logger.doc:name: Salesforce Access Token Generated Successfully
